action.action-desc: Mr. Reschenthaler (for himself, Mr. Steube, Mr. Armstrong, Mr. Perry, Mr. Nunes, and Mr. Jordan) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To amend title 18, United States Code, to repeal the provision relating to private correspondence with foreign governments, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Time to Repeal an Archaic Policy Act of 2020 or the TRAP Act of 2020 .

section.header: Repeal of provision relating to private correspondence with foreign governments

subsection.text: Section 953 of title 18, United States Code, is repealed.
The table of sections at the beginning of chapter 45 of title 18, United States Code, is amended by striking the item relating to section 953.
The repeal made by subsection (a) shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this Act.
